purpose: Retroactive stack disclosure for the sealed GLM-5.3-Flash fidelity rows, answering a community reviewer's questions ('What vLLM runner is used, do you record what specific kernels are used? Do you enable enforce-eager?') with per-row, per-fact, source-attributed evidence — by digest. Rows measured AFTER 2026-08-29 embed a live stack fingerprint (malaiwah.stack-fingerprint.v1) instead; this file exists because the sealed rows predate it. Method and refusability rule: WHAT-WE-MEASURE.md section 7 in the harness repo (github.com/malaiwah/quant-fidelity-suite).

source_legend.log_evidence: the value is printed in the engine launch log of that exact run, named by the log file's sha256 (private scratch dataset)
source_legend.published_file_digest: the value is the content of a published file, named by its sha256
source_legend.unknown: no surviving artifact establishes the value; it is listed, not guessed
